name: What is the process for converting a garage into an ADU?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for converting a garage into an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a garage into an ADU involves several steps: initial consultation and design, architectural plans, permit acquisition, demolition (if necessary), foundation work, framing, electrical and plumbing installation, insulation, drywall, flooring, and finishing touches. Our team handles project management, ensuring compliance with local building codes in areas like Pacifica and Daly City.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes design, permits, demolition, framing, utility installation, and finishing work, managed by our team.
